title: Open Source
description: Can read a license, open a justified issue-linked PR, and practice maintainership — triage, review and SemVer notes — on a real public project.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can name a public repo's SPDX license, quote whether CONTRIBUTING exists, and record clone/build commands with an exit code — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can open a small PR linked to a real upstream issue, follow the project's commit or DCO/CLA rule, and keep a journal of review feedback and the response.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently triage public issues with a closed set of next actions, review a public PR naming files from the diff, and draft SemVer release notes citing real commits or PRs.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can ship a maintainer packet with will-respond and will-not-respond boundaries, accept or reject work against license and SemVer constraints, and produce notes another maintainer can act on from URLs alone.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's contribution or packet, name an invented issue URL or a license obligation they skipped, and teach when to close-as-wontfix versus ask-for-info on an unfamiliar project.
